pull.title: BIP 440, 441: revise costs from measured primitives
pull.body:
Update to BIP 440 and BIP 441 (version 0.3.0).

BIP 440:
- only Tapleaf 0xc2 inputs fund the budget; legacy, witness v0, key path and Tapleaf 0xc0 inputs no longer do
- flat cost for every opcode and literal push
- variable costs composed from measured primitives, priced from benchmarks on several machines
- one SIGCHECK per elliptic curve operation
- security considerations for the shared budget

BIP 441:
- opcode costs composed from BIP 440's primitives
- five opcode definitions corrected
- states that BIP 342's sigops budget does not apply
- security considerations

events.body: Concept ACK. Are you looking for reviews from any particular people, or independent/additional benchmarks on hardware?

> Concept ACK. Are you looking for reviews from any particular people, or independent/additional benchmarks on hardware?

An interesting benchmark would be from a non Apple Arm64 chip like a Snapdragon X, but I don't think it's required for this PR, the exact values can easily be adjusted in the future, and since each price covers the slowest of the existing seven machines, any additional machine would only change a price if it is slower than all of the existing ones, relative to its own reference workload, which is unlikely.

I would be delighted to see review by @ajtowns, @instagibbs, @darosior, who showed interest in the budget in the past, but from our side this is ready.

this page also summarizes and visualizes the calibration:
https://jmoik.github.io/varopsData/report/calibration.html
